key_insight: Coordinate-conditioned neural fields reconstruct fine-scale 3D reacting-flow structures better than tricubic interpolation, while hierarchical reconstruction reduces coarse-cell imprinting.
engineering_relevance: The approach could help recover flame wrinkling and local curvature from coarse reacting-flow fields for more detailed engineering analysis.
method: Condition spatial coordinates on local coarse-grid thermochemical information, without radiance prediction or volume rendering.
Compress the thermochemical state using principal component analysis.
Progressively reconstruct intermediate resolution levels with hierarchical NFSR.
evidence_signal: On 3D DNS data for a turbulent premixed hydrogen–air flame coarsened eightfold per coordinate direction, NFSR outperformed tricubic interpolation on an unseen test realization.
watch_item: Generalization beyond the evaluated flame configuration remains unestablished.
paper_title: NeRF-Inspired Neural Fields for 3D Super-resolution of Reacting-Flows
